summary: Completed testing of MamanDouce refactoring (AuthPage, HomePage) and new TrackingPage with pregnancy tracking graphs. All features working correctly.

HomePage.js refactored from ~892 lines to ~200 lines (-78%) - all navigation sections working with proper data-testid attributes
New TrackingPage.js (538 lines) properly implemented with recharts graphs for weight and baby growth tracking
Auth components properly extracted to /components/auth/: LoginForm, RegisterForm, ForgotPasswordForm, TwoFactorInput, BiometricPrompt, PinSetup, QuickLogin
Home components properly extracted to /components/home/: AgendaCard, PregnancyCards, NavigationSections, TopBar
All data-testid attributes properly added for testing: auth-card, email-input, password-input, submit-button, tracking-nav, weight-chart, baby-chart, add-weight-btn, add-baby-btn
Backend API /api/medical/health-summary correctly returns weight_history, blood_pressure_history, baby_growth_history arrays
